chunks: Those whose effort is misspent in pursuit of the pleasures of the world, even though they think they are doing good things.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when people think they are doing good but their efforts are in vain?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *al-husn al-zann* (good opinion) of the self, where the ego deceives the individual into believing their worldly efforts are righteous despite lacking divine alignment. It underscores the critical distinction between subjective self-assurance and objective spiritual reality, a theme frequently explored in the context of the *Ahl al-Bayt*'s teachings on inner sincerity versus outward appearance.
